exclusions: Generic Voyager payment processing does not inherit Voyager Fleet rules.

inventory.quote: 9. Voyager Fleet Card Processing
9.1. Processing Requirements
The following transactions are supported for the Voyager fleet card:
the Merchant Profile at BUYPASS must have Terminal Special Code 073 enabled.
The POS application must be able to read the Card Type code 060 sent in the Table Load response.
the application must provide a method to determine whether Voyager fleet cards are allowed.
Please refer to the applicable message format specifications for information about valid Prompt Codes for the Voyager fleet card.
If it is required, it can have a length of 1–6 digits. It should be unencrypted in the message format for BUYPASS.
If unable to read the magnetic stripe after three attempts, the device should prompt for manual entry of the 19-digit Voyager fleet card Account Number.
The Restriction Code value must follow the Expiration Date in the Discretionary Data Field sent to the host.
this fact is indicated on the receipt and journal by an asterisk (*) before the Account Number.
the ISO Number is prompted for and is prefixed to the Account Number.
The device must perform an expiration date validation on all Voyager fleet card transactions.
Perform a Mod 10 Check Digit evaluation on the Account Number Check Digit
Perform a Mod 10 Check Digit evaluation on the Super Check Digit
If it is required, the odometer reading can have a length of 1–8 digits.
For Magstripe transactions, there is no Vehicle Number for the Voyager fleet card.
the device must interpret the value of the Restriction Code—in the Track 1 or Track 2 data—to see whether the transaction is for “fuel and other products” or “fuel only.”
A unique Product Code must be sent for each type of fuel purchase.
The approved maximum dollar amount will be less than or equal to the amount in the Authorization Request.
approval/denial is based on the actual amount sent in the Authorization Request.
The Product Code Data must be sent in all fleet transactions. The sum of all the products in the product segment must equal the total transaction amount.
The default track that is sent to BUYPASS on an original transaction should be Track 2.
Card data provided in a follow-on transaction must be partial Track 2 Data.
This does not apply to the TransArmor-VeriFone Edition processing when sending full Track 2 Data.
9.2. EMV Processing Requirements
This section contains the following Voyager Chip requirements information:
terminals must check position 31 (Track2) or position 58 (track1) to determine if the service code begins with a ‘2’ or ‘6’.
Please see Voyager EMV terminal Specifications v1.5 for more details.
crossReferences: Voyager EMV terminal Specifications v1.5; Truck Class field

inventory.quote: Voyager requires that the Voyager Fleet Card payment application will be priority 1.
Voyager Proprietary Third Party Data Layout
A value of ‘0003’ or ‘8003’ in the Unique Identifier of the Third Party Data (9F6E) indicates that Enhanced Fleet Prompting is supported by the card product.
These fields must be prompted in the order of the highest order bit defined (bit 4, then bit 3, etc.).
See ‘Appendix I, “Voyager Chip-Specific POS Prompt Codes.’ for specifics on Enhanced prompts.
For EMV transactions, the device must interpret the value of the Restriction Code—from Tag 9F6E Third Part Data —to see whether the transaction is for “fuel and other products” or “fuel only.”
When the card is removed from the chip reader before a “card removal request” from the terminal, the transaction must be aborted.
If the terminal has already received an authorization response from the Voyager Authorization Host, the terminal must send a reversal message to the Voyager Authorization Host.
The terminal should support a maintenance function allowing to print or to display the information stored.
Before the 1st GENERATE AC command, the card may be simply powered off.
